title: bst/1 parameter file
description: One member of the family bst/1, as model.md names its free parameters, in BST's notation. Draft.
$comment: This validator checks names, types and ranges. The checker checks the rest: shares summing to one, types in increasing order of beta with no repeat, income 0 when the unemployment probability is 0, the scale condition wp * xi_min < 1, the artificial borrowing constraint no lower than the natural one, each shock law's own rules, and the validity conditions of conditions.md.

period.description: The length of a period, as a label. Every rate and probability in the file is per period.

crra.description: rho, the coefficient of relative risk aversion, greater than 1 as in BST.

types.description: The discount-factor types, in increasing order of beta, with population shares omega summing to one.

survival.description: The survival probability (BST's script L); 1 switches mortality off.

return.description: R, the gross return on assets.

borrowing_constraint.description: The artificial borrowing constraint a_Art, the lowest permitted end-of-period assets as a ratio to permanent income: a number no greater than 0 and no lower than the natural constraint a_Nat, or the word natural for a_Art = a_Nat.

growth.description: The growth factor of permanent income (BST's script G).

prob.description: wp, the probability of the unemployment event each period. With 0, income must be 0 too, so that the file has one written form.

income.description: xi_min, the transitory shock's value in the unemployment event: income while unemployed as a ratio to permanent income; 0 in BST.

employed_shock.description: The law of theta, the employed draw, before the scaling (1 - wp xi_min)/(1 - wp) that keeps the mean of the transitory shock at one.
